sources.title: Lightning OPD 2.0: Mitigating Style Bias in Cross-Teacher On-Policy ...
sources.snippet: This condition means that the teacher used for OPD is the same model that generated the demonstrations used to train the SFT reference policy. Teacher consistency aligns the token-level distillation signal with the behavior already learned by the reference policy, which allows fully offline Lightning OPD to closely track standard online OPD.

sources.title: Recursive Self-Improvement via On-Policy Distillation for Reasoning
sources.snippet: Abstract On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model by having it generate trajectories, then matching its next-token predictions with an external teacher's next-token predictions. This provides a dense, token-level supervision to the student. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) eliminates the need for the external teacher.
